**rs7412 (APOE) – allele‑frequency in European populations**

| Data source | Population subset | Minor allele (T) frequency |
|-------------|-------------------|----------------------------|
| **gnomAD v3.1.1** | Non‑Finnish European (N ≈ 60 000) | **≈ 0.12** (12 %) |
| **gnomAD v3.1.1** | Finnish European (N ≈ 10 000) | ≈ 0.10 (10 %) |
| **1000 Genomes Project** | CEU (Utah residents with Northern/Western European ancestry) | ≈ 0.13 |
| **1000 Genomes Project** | TSI (Toscani in Italy) | ≈ 0.11 |
| **1000 Genomes Project** | IBS (Iberian population in Spain) | ≈ 0.12 |

> **Interpretation**  
> The T allele of rs7412 corresponds to the ε2 allele of the APOE gene. Across the major European reference panels, the ε2 allele is present in roughly 10–13 % of chromosomes, with a mean of about 12 %. Frequencies can vary slightly among sub‑populations (e.g., slightly lower in Finnish cohorts).

### Quick reference links
- **gnomAD**: https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/
- **1000 Genomes**: https://www.internationalgenome.org/

> *Note*: These figures are derived from large, publicly available datasets and represent the best current estimates. If you need the most up‑to‑date or region‑specific data, consult the latest releases of gnomAD or the 1000 Genomes Project.
